purpose: Bounded Scopus supplement for Engineering Reliable Coding Agents; this is review provenance, not a SciX corpus ingest.
retention_boundary: Retain query provenance and DOI/Scopus EID identifiers only. Do not retain or redistribute Scopus-returned titles, abstracts, authors, or full text.
screening_boundary: Scopus-returned content is reserved for human screening. Automated analysis may use independently obtained, appropriately licensed metadata while preserving its source lane.

topics.query: TITLE-ABS-KEY(("systematic literature review" OR "systematic mapping study" OR "multivocal literature review" OR "grey literature") AND "software engineering")
TITLE-ABS-KEY(("coding agent" OR "program repair" OR "code generation") AND (benchmark OR evaluation OR contamination OR oracle))
TITLE-ABS-KEY(("automated evaluation" OR "human evaluation" OR "inter-rater agreement") AND (software OR code))
TITLE-ABS-KEY(("code review" OR "pull request review") AND ("artificial intelligence" OR automation OR human))
TITLE-ABS-KEY((agent OR automation) AND ("fault injection" OR recovery OR reliability OR idempotent))
TITLE-ABS-KEY(("code search" OR "repository retrieval" OR "issue localization") AND (context OR developer))
TITLE-ABS-KEY(("multi-agent" OR "multi agent") AND ("software engineering" OR programming) AND (coordination OR delegation))
TITLE-ABS-KEY(("generative AI" OR "artificial intelligence") AND ("software engineering" OR programming) AND (adoption OR governance OR accountability))

venues.filter: EXACTSRCTITLE("ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology")
EXACTSRCTITLE("Proceedings of the ACM on Human-Computer Interaction") OR CONFNAME("Computer Supported Cooperative Work")
